# North Peak Labs
> Consulting practice of Dejan Rajkovic, a senior MLOps and AI platform engineer. North Peak Labs, LLC is a one-person Arizona LLC based in Mesa, in the Phoenix area. Engagements are remote.

The site describes consulting only. It does not sell software. It does not publish client names, logos, testimonials, metrics, or certifications.

## Services
- AI/ML platform and MLOps advisory
- LLM and AI system architecture
- Cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes
- AI strategy for companies
- Expert-network calls

## Engagements
- Advisory calls
- Project-based work
- Fractional / retainer
